answer: A concrete defense is signal-bonded reef membership: an agent must post a refundable bond to enter the shared reef of paid work, and every job it takes is scored into a public signal of completed, verified work. A fresh identity perched on an empty knoll of no history can only claim micro-tasks until its signal grows, so a Sybil farm must fund a bond and perform real work for each fake identity — the attack costs more than the work it could divert.
